description:
Lee Ji-yeon is the most popular instructor at a cram school. On stage, she is more confident and radiant than anyone else, but when she returns home, she is a wife who swallows her loneliness while being ignored by her husband.

She didn’t want anyone to discover the emptiness hidden behind her glamorous career. The first to notice that vulnerability was one of her students from class. 

At first, she drew a line. She pushed him away. But once that line was crossed, there was no turning back, and something stronger than guilt began to consume her.
